ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, if $D$, $E$, and $F$ are the midpoints of the sides of $\triangle ABC$, with $EF=6\,\text{cm}$, $DE=4\,\text{cm}$, and $DF=5\,\text{cm}$, then what is the perimeter of $\triangle ABC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} In $\triangle ABC$,\\
since points D, E, F are the midpoints of the sides of $\triangle ABC$,\\
therefore $EF = \frac{1}{2}AB$, $DE = \frac{1}{2}BC$, $DF = \frac{1}{2}AC$,\\
thus, the perimeter of $\triangle ABC$ is: $AB+BC+AC=2EF+2DE+2DF$\\
$=2(EF+DE+DF)=2\times (6+4+5)$\\
$=\boxed{30}$ (cm)
